people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He built altars in Yahweh’s house, of which Yahweh said, “My name shall be in Jerusalem forever.”
translations.bsb: Manasseh also built altars in the house of the LORD, of which the LORD had said, “My Name will remain in Jerusalem forever.”
translations.kjv: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
translations.asv: And he built altars in the house of Jehovah, whereof Jehovah said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.
